title: Adventurous Autumn Argentinian Apple Empanadas
description: A low-calorie Argentinian dish featuring braeburn apples and miso marinate, with a bitter and molten flavor profile, perfect for adventurous eaters. This dish is a unique twist on traditional empanadas.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Add the low-fat butter to the bowl and mix until a crumbly dough forms.
Gradually add cold water to the bowl and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place a few slices of apple in the center of each circle.
Drizzle the miso paste over the apple slices.
Fold the dough over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg.
Bake the empanadas for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
